lines.text: The Teacher saw nothing better for a man than to eat and drink, because that is his lot.
He admired the dead over the living, but said better than both is he who has not seen death.

wrong_details.true: has not seen the evil that is done under the sun

problems.problem: Its wrong detail "rest from his work" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
Its wrong detail "the living" is in Ecclesiastes 4:2, so it isn't wrong.
